pdp.meta_description: Custom prestige plastic name badges with full-color printing, epoxy coating, and free doming. Durable, professional, and customizable.
pdp.description_html:
Elevate your brand with our custom Prestige Name Tags, designed to combine vibrant full-color printing with durability and customization. Perfect for businesses, events, and organizations, these name badges offer a professional and polished look.

  • Full Custom Color Printing: Enjoy vibrant, full-color printing of logos and text, ensuring your brand stands out.
  • Pin or Magnetic Fastener: Choose between pin or magnetic fasteners for easy attachment and versatility.
  • Scratch and Fade-Proof Epoxy Coating: Our badges feature a durable epoxy coating that protects against scratches and fading, ensuring they look great for a long time.
  • Rapid Production Times: Benefit from quick turnaround times, ensuring you receive your badges promptly.
  • No Setup Fees & No Design Fees: Start your order without any additional setup or design costs.
  • Free Doming: Enhance the look of your badges with free doming, adding a glossy and professional finish.
  • No Minimums: Order as many or as few as you need, with no minimum order requirements.
  • No Hidden Fees: Enjoy transparent pricing with no hidden charges.
  • Quantity-Based Prices: Enjoy competitive pricing with discounts based on order quantity.

Order Your Name Badges Today! Make a lasting impression with vibrant, durable, and customizable name badges. Perfect for businesses, events, and organizations, these badges offer a professional look with the added benefit of durability. Click the "Buy Now" button and elevate your brand with our Plastic Name Tags & Custom Name Badges!
